command: set -o pipefail; echo '=== ID ==='; hostname; id -un; echo '=== DESKTOP CANDIDATES ==='; find "$HOME/.local/share/applications" "$HOME/Desktop" "$HOME/.config/autostart" -maxdepth 2 -type f \( -name '*.desktop' -o -name '*.sh' \) 2>/dev/null | while read -r f; do if grep -Eqi 'free[ -]?frank|frankenstein|127\.0\.0\.1:8788|8788|frank' "$f"; then echo "--- $f"; sed -n '1,140p' "$f"; fi; done; echo '=== GNOME FAVORITES ==='; gsettings get org.gnome.shell favorite-apps 2>&1 || true; echo '=== SERVICE ==='; systemctl --user --no-pager --full status frankenstein-buehne.service 2>&1 | sed -n '1,80p' || true; echo '=== PORT 8788 ==='; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ':8788' || true; echo '=== BROWSER PROCESSES ==='; pgrep -af 'chrome|chromium|brave|firefox' | head -30 || true; echo '=== RECENT JOURNAL ==='; journalctl --user -u frankenstein-buehne.service -n 40 --no-pager 2>&1 || true
